item.title: Elon Musk clarifies Tesla Cybertruck ’10 day’ comment, fans respond
item.description: Some are arguing that the decision to confirm a price hike in ten days is sort of counterproductive, especially considering it is based on demand. Giving consumers a timeline of just ten days to make a big purchase like a pickup truck for $60,000, and basically stating the price will go up, will only push people to make a reservation. The post Elon Musk clarifies Tesla Cybertruck ’10 day’ comment, fans respond appeared first on TESLARATI.
